Independent variables
Two independent variables were used. The environmental
attitude of urban vs open-air person was the first variable.

persons”. The second independent variable, culture, was
defined as two groups of participants visiting the Swedish
andtheJapanesesquare,respectively.Thetwogroupswere
considered as living in two different cultures.
